summary.value: The reviewers were split about this paper and did not come to a consensus. On one hand they appreciated the model architecture and the ablations. On the other they had issues with (a) small improvements, (b) similarity to existing ideas, (c) limited architectures, (d) a missing computation-matched comparison, (e) missing details on SFT. The authors responded to all of these points convincingly. As all of the concerns have been responded to, I vote to accept.

reviewer_scores.value: I think all reviewers would have kept their score or increased it.
